text:
anya: Quick greenfield pilot sync — kickoff with ProspectX on Mon. Need owners for the remaining integration deliverables and CRs. TL;DR: webhook contract, schema migration, certs & network, SSO, staging window. Who owns what?

mike: I can own the webhook contract + integration tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/421 — awaiting CR. @sasha can you review?

sasha: on it, I pinged on the PR and will review tomorrow morning. note: need sample payloads from SE to write test vectors.

jamie (SE): sending sample payloads now — small example added here:
```json
{"user_id":"123","query":"summarize: last 3 interactions","metadata":{"source":"app"}}
```

mike: added Jamie's sample to the PR. filed INTG-2345 for the schema change so we can track migrations and tests.

victor: network/certs item — staging needs IP allowlist + wildcard certs. who will request the cert and update route tables?

anya: infra ownership on certs + routes. @devops-bot please schedule a staging preflight for 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC so infra can make changes.

devops-bot: [automated] Staging preflight requested: 2026-03-23T02:00Z. Requested by @anya. Assigned infra owner: @victor. Reply here to confirm.

sasha: I can run smoke tests during that window — checklist: health endpoint, kv-cache warm, sample payload run (see Jamie), and token budget sanity.

mike: DB migration PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/db-migrations/pull/78 — backward compatible, adds nullable column. migration task created as INTG-2346. plan: deploy, run backfill, monitor 1h.

jamie (SE): Customer success criteria: median latency < 1s for simple queries, 99% success on sample workload, schema backwards compatible. Also they require SSO (SAML) to work for one pilot admin.

anya: noted. who owns SSO config for the pilot? @kelly can you take point? we need SP metadata by Friday.

kelly: will take SSO. I need SP metadata and contact from Jamie by EOD Thu. I'll post the config steps and a checklist.

victor: infra update — staging VPC ready, just waiting on final IP list and cert issuance. I'll update the route table once IPs are locked.

mike: quick CR ping @sasha — PR 421 is green except two tiny nits I addressed. once those are resolved it's ready.

sasha: reviewed, left two comments inline. should be green after fixes + CI run.

anya: ok team — target: all PRs merged and migration scheduled by Fri EOD. If any blocker surfaces, flag here immediately. :eyes: :thumbsup:

jamie (SE): onboarding doc draft: https://docs.redwood.com/poc/prospectx-onboard-draft — includes success criteria and sample test plan. feedback welcome.

devops-bot: Deploy job queued: staging-deploy/2026-03-22-12:10 (depends on PR 421 merge).

mike: note — feature flag gating pilot traffic: `pilot/prospectx_enabled`. I'll add a config toggle in console and a rollout plan (10% -> 50% -> 100%).

sasha: will validate flag toggles in staging after deploy and run smoke tests.

anya: last ask — please keep CR pings for final approval only after CI passes. If you request an expedited review, mark with "EXPEDITE" in the PR title. Thanks all.

mike: will do. tagging owners below for quick rollcall: Webhook/PR - @mike, DB migration - @mike, Smoke tests - @sasha, Infra/routes/certs - @victor, SSO - @kelly, Customer liaison/docs - @jamie (SE).

victor: confirmed infra will handle certs and route table updates during preflight.

sasha: confirmed smoke test owner and availability for the preflight window.

anya: perfect — next checkpoint here Friday 17:00 UTC. If anything shifts earlier, post updates. :calendar:
